data.title: Dolls
data.statement:
Challenge: Find the Creepy Doll!

There is a local legend about a creepy doll named Saras, who is said to move around on her own. Saras can be found in random places, and it’s rumored that she hides in the shadows of abandoned houses and haunted schools. Your task is to write a simple code to determine your priority of places you need to go until you found Saras.
Check if "Saras" is present in the place. If not, sage the place for protection.

testCases.title: Dollface
testCases.testOut: Found Saras in the Dark Room!

testCases.title: Smiling doll
testCases.testOut: Found Saras in the Music Room!

data.constraints:
Additional Info:

1. Saras could only be in one place at a time.
2. Places with no Saras need to be sage for protection
data.inputDescription:
Input Example:

places = ["old house", "bathroom", "backyard", "kitchen", "garage", "haunted school", "dark room", "music room"]
